test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "Houses, chairs, and toys..." **lists multiple items, so the plural form **"are"** is the correct conjugation of the verb to agree with the plural subject. 
 
• The verb** "made" **is in the past participle form, which is appropriate following a form of** "to be" **in passive voice constructions.
 
• The passive voice **("are made")** correctly indicates that houses, chairs, and toys are created using wood without specifying who makes them.
 
• **"From wood"** correctly describes the material used in the construction of houses, chairs, and toys.
 
• Using** "are made"** fits the present simple tense, which is commonly used for general facts and truths.
 
• The entire phrase **"are made from wood we receive from trees"** clearly communicates the relationship between the objects and their source material.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (was make): Incorrect because "was make" is grammatically incorrect; "was" should be followed by the past participle "made."
 
• Option 2 (had make): Incorrect because "had make" is not a recognized conjugation; it should be "had made."
 
• Option 3 (will made): Incorrect because "will made" is incorrect tense-wise; it should be "will be made."
